Name: Valley Shuffle
Author: stardemod
Description: This mod randomly repositions all objects, terrain features, resources, debris, furnitures and buildings on your farm and across the map every 10 in-game minutes. Embrace the unpredictable — no more predictable farm layouts, just a constant challenge to adapt and explore!

Manifest.Description: Randomly repositioning all objects on the map every 10 in-game minutes
